Your files.
Your decision.

Access is a choice. Clearing is a choice. A useful storage app should make both easy to understand.

Choose access.

Native folder pickers keep permission requests in context. Coverage depends on the folders and resources macOS permits.

Review the change.

Supported cleanup is reviewed before anything moves. Suggestions do not authorize deletion or prove redundancy.

Keep a way back.

Eligible changes use Trash and recovery receipts. Disk space is released when Trash is emptied; Room will not empty it for you.

A few clear answers.

When is it available?

Room is being prepared for the Mac App Store. There is no public Store download yet. The release will be free, with no ads or in-app purchases.

What Mac will it need?

The planned first release targets Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. On-device analysis also depends on Apple Intelligence support and availability.

Will it close my apps?

No. The planned Store edition offers memory monitoring and guidance, with no control that quits other applications. It also excludes the direct edition’s external model-runtime integration.

Does it scan everything?

No. Scans are limited by approved access, macOS permissions and inspection budgets. Large, hidden or cache-like files are never automatically considered unnecessary.
